name: QuestionnaireFieldMapping
title: Questionnaire field mapping
description: How a Questionnaire item's answer maps onto a pedigree person: `mapsToField`; `mapsToCondition`; `mapsToObservation`; `mapsToLegendCondition`; `mapsToLegendObservation`; `invokesAction`. `mapsToField` binds the item to a person property named by item.definition (a Patient element, or a PedigreeIndividual element); `mapsToCondition`/`mapsToObservation` make a Condition/Observation with item.code; the legend kinds make a repeating, terminology-backed, colour-legend item; `invokesAction` makes a button (see questionnaire-action).
